method: Read-only static source/template/binding inspection; no browser, build, test, SQL or repo edits. Original dirty checkout read only. Smallest lenses: Cartesian doubt and Systems Thinking.
interpretation: User-visible task outcomes and interactions must survive native Leptos implementation, with real owners and policy. Prototype simulation, erroneous claims, hardcoded identity and fake delivery must not be ported. This checklist supplies parity evidence to existing authorities/inventory, not another roadmap.
acceptance_common: Create demo data through actual browser UI only; authenticate and authorize server-side; commit through canonical owner; reopen exact result; independently verify durable effects. Exercise denied/expired/revoked, stale/duplicate/interrupted and keyboard/IME/narrow states. Every exposed control/link works; no fake successes or seeded fallback.

cross_cutting_conflicts_to_adapt: Payroll approval must not schedule/execute direct bank payments.
Rank/title/hierarchy/manager labels never supply implicit authority.
Account persists independently from Employment; departure revokes scoped grants, not identity.
Cross-Company drag or Group scope cannot merge Company payroll truth.
Do not identify people by display name or reject legitimate namesakes.
Simulated undo/status replacement must become append-only authorized correction.
Money, legal filing deadlines, staffing decisions and Korean calculations require actual independently validated rules; prototype constants are not oracles.
